A student exports a class list to use in a different app. The tool reads the workbook with SheetJS in your browser and writes the first sheet as comma-separated values. Only the first sheet is exported; other sheets are left out.
content.tip: Move the sheet you need to the first position in your workbook before you convert, because only the first sheet is exported. Open the .csv afterwards to check that dates and numbers look right.
content.limit: Only the first sheet is exported. Formulas are saved as their calculated values, and formatting, colours, charts and other sheets are not kept. An empty first sheet gives an error and nothing is downloaded.
content.example: Converting a workbook whose first sheet has 50 rows of stock data downloads ak-premium-sheet.csv with all 50 rows as comma-separated values.
faq: Which sheet is exported?
Only the first sheet of the workbook. If the sheet you need is second or third, move it to the first position in Excel and save, then convert again.
Does the CSV keep my formulas?
No. Formulas are saved as their calculated values. The .csv file holds plain values separated by commas, with no formatting.
What happens if the first sheet is empty?
The tool shows a message that the first sheet is empty and downloads nothing. Choose a workbook with data on the first sheet.
Can I convert a .xls file too?
Yes. Both .xlsx and .xls files are accepted by the file picker.

tools.meta_description: Save CSV text as an .xlsx spreadsheet, free in your browser. Paste CSV rows and download Excel instantly.
steps: Choose a .csv file with the file button, or paste CSV text in the 'Paste CSV text' box.
Press Convert CSV to Excel.
Save the downloaded .xlsx file.

content.use: CSV to Excel turns a .csv file or pasted CSV text into a proper Excel workbook, so the data opens in Excel with rows and columns. A shop owner turns a downloaded sales CSV into an Excel file to sort and filter it. An office worker turns a system export into Excel to add totals. A student turns survey results into Excel to make a chart. You can upload a file or paste the text; either way the tool reads the rows with SheetJS and writes one sheet in an .xlsx file. The first row becomes the header row of the sheet.
content.tip: Check that the first row holds your column names, because it becomes the header row. If your CSV uses semicolons instead of commas, replace them first, or the columns will not split correctly.
content.limit: The result is one plain sheet with no formatting, formulas or charts. The tool expects commas between values; quoted commas inside a value are handled, but very unusual CSV files may not split correctly. An empty file or empty paste gives an error.
content.example: Pasting 'name,age' on the first line and 'Ali,25' on the second, then pressing Convert CSV to Excel, downloads an .xlsx file with a Name column and an Age column.
faq: Do I need to upload a file, or can I paste text?
Either works. Choose a .csv file, or paste the CSV text into the box. If you do both, the uploaded file is used.
What becomes the header row?
The first row of your CSV becomes the header row of the Excel sheet, so put your column names there.
Does the Excel file keep my formatting?
No. The result is a plain sheet with values only. Add colours, filters and formulas in Excel afterwards.
What if my CSV uses semicolons?
The tool expects commas. Replace the semicolons with commas first, or the whole row will land in one column.

short.en: Shrink photos and images for sharing.

steps: Choose one or more images with the file button.
Pick JPEG, PNG or WebP and set the quality, or enter a target size in KB.
Press Compress and download the smaller image, or the ZIP file if there is more than one.

content.use: Compressing images is for photos that are too large to upload, email or post: a product photo for an online store, a scanned document photo, or a picture for a website. Smaller images load faster and use less data.
content.tip: If you need a file under a specific size, enter the target size in KB and let the tool lower the quality step by step until it fits. WebP usually gives the smallest file at good quality.
content.limit: JPEG output flattens transparency, so a PNG with a transparent background becomes a white background. PNG output keeps transparency but may stay large. The tool works on one image at a time in the browser, so very large batches take a while.
content.example: A 4 MB phone photo at 80% JPEG quality often becomes about 800 KB with no visible difference on a screen.
faq: Which format should I choose?
JPEG for photos, PNG when you need transparency or sharp text, WebP when you want the smallest file and the place you are uploading it accepts WebP.
Can I compress many images at once?
Yes. Choose several images and they are all compressed. If there is more than one, you also get a ZIP file with all of them in it.
Does it change the size of the picture?
No. The width and height in pixels stay the same. Only the file gets smaller, because the picture is saved again at a lower quality.
What does the target size box do?
It tells the tool the largest file you want, in KB. For JPEG and WebP it lowers the quality step by step until the file fits, or until quality reaches 10 percent.

tools.meta_description: Compress JPG, PNG and WebP images into smaller JPEGs, free in your browser. Same images, smaller files.
Resize images by width and height in pixels, free in your browser. No upload, no sign-up.
steps: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image with the file button. The original size is filled in for you.
Type the Width and Height in pixels. Tick 'Keep aspect ratio' to change the other side automatically.
Choose PNG or JPEG as the output format, then press Resize Image and save the result.

content.use: Image Resizer changes the width and height of a picture in pixels, so it fits a form, a profile photo box or a slide. A student resizes a photo to the size a portal asks for. A shop owner resizes product photos so they all match on a website. An office worker resizes a picture to fit a slide. When you pick a file, the tool fills in its real size for you. Tick 'Keep aspect ratio' and the other side changes automatically, so the picture does not stretch. You can save the result as PNG or JPEG.
content.tip: Keep 'Keep aspect ratio' ticked unless you want to stretch the picture on purpose. Resizing a small picture much larger will make it blurry, so start from the biggest original you have.
content.limit: Width and height must each be between 1 and 8000 pixels. The picture is stretched to exactly the size you type when aspect ratio is off, which can distort it. Saving as JPEG flattens transparency onto a white background, because JPEG has no transparency.
content.example: Resizing a 2000 by 1500 photo to 800 by 600 with 'Keep aspect ratio' ticked downloads a sharp 800 by 600 picture.
faq: What does 'Keep aspect ratio' do?
When it is ticked, changing the width updates the height automatically, and changing the height updates the width, so the picture keeps its shape and does not stretch.
What is the biggest size I can use?
Width and height must each be between 1 and 8000 pixels. Bigger values are refused with a message.
Why did my PNG lose its transparent background?
You saved it as JPEG. JPEG has no transparency, so the background becomes white. Choose PNG as the output format to keep transparency.
Does resizing make a small photo sharper?
No. Making a small photo bigger only stretches the pixels it already has, so it looks blurry. Start from the largest original you have.

tools.meta_description: Change image format between JPG, PNG and WebP, free in your browser. Convert images without uploading them.
steps: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image with the file button.
Pick the output format: JPG, PNG or WebP.
Press Convert Image and save the downloaded file.

content.use: Image Converter changes a picture from one format to another, JPG, PNG or WebP, without changing its size. A student turns a PNG screenshot into a JPG to upload to a portal that only takes JPG. A shop owner turns product photos into WebP so the website loads faster. An office worker turns a JPG photo into PNG to edit it in a program that needs PNG. The picture keeps its original width and height; only the file format changes. The conversion runs in your browser, so your photo is never uploaded.
content.tip: Use JPG for photos you want to share or upload, because it makes smaller files. Use PNG when you need transparency or sharp text, and WebP when you want a modern format with small files.
content.limit: Only JPG, PNG and WebP are accepted, and the output is one of the same three formats. The picture keeps its original size; this tool does not resize it. Saving as JPG flattens transparency onto a white background, because JPG has no transparency.
content.example: Converting a 1200 by 800 PNG screenshot to JPG downloads the same 1200 by 800 picture as a smaller JPG file.
faq: Which formats can I convert between?
JPG, PNG and WebP, in any direction. Pick the image, choose the output format, and press Convert Image.
Does the picture change size?
No. The width and height stay exactly the same. Only the file format changes. Use Image Resizer if you also need a different size.
Why did my transparent PNG get a white background?
You converted it to JPG. JPG has no transparency, so the see-through parts become white. Convert to PNG or WebP instead to keep transparency.
Can I convert several images at once?
No. The tool converts one image at a time. Repeat the steps for each picture you need.

steps: Choose an image with the file button.
Pick the language of the text in the image (English, Urdu, Arabic or Hindi).
Press Read Text and copy the result. The first run downloads language data, so it takes longer.

content.use: Reading text from an image is for typed notes, a screenshot of a message, a photo of a notice board, or a scanned page that needs to become editable text. It saves retyping the whole thing by hand.
content.tip: Choose the right language before you start. Urdu text needs the Urdu option, and a clear, straight photo with good light gives far better results than a tilted or blurry one.
content.limit: Text recognition works best on clear printed text. Handwriting, fancy fonts, low light and tilted photos give poor results. The first run downloads language data, so it takes longer the first time.
content.example: A photo of a shop notice in Urdu becomes editable Urdu text you can paste into a document.
faq: Does it read Urdu text?
Yes. Choose Urdu (urd) in the language list before you press Read Text. English, Arabic and Hindi are also available.
Why is some text wrong or missing?
The photo may be tilted, blurry or low contrast. Try a straighter, brighter photo, and crop out anything that is not text before you upload it.
Can it read English and Urdu in one image?
Yes. Choose English + Urdu in the language list. The tool reads both scripts from the same image in one run.
How do I copy the result?
Press the Copy Text button under the result box. It copies all the recognized text, so you can paste it into a document or message.

tools.meta_description: Read text from an image with OCR, free in your browser. Best on clear printed text; needs a language download first.

short.en: Text or URL as QR code.

steps: Type the text or web address in the 'Text or URL' box.
Press Generate QR Code. The code appears on the page.
Press Download QR PNG to save the code as a picture.
tools.meta_description: Generate QR codes from text or a URL, free in your browser. Download your QR code as a PNG instantly.

content.use: QR Code Generator turns any text or web address into a QR code picture, so people can scan it with a phone instead of typing. A shop owner prints a QR code for a payment link on the counter. A teacher prints a QR code for a class form on a handout. A student puts a QR code for a portfolio link on a resume. You type the text or link, press Generate QR Code, and the code appears on the page at 220 pixels wide. Press Download QR PNG to save it as a picture you can print or paste into a document.
content.tip: Test the code with your own phone camera before you print it. Short links make simpler codes that scan more easily, so use a short URL when you can.
content.limit: The code is a picture of the text you typed; it does not check that a link works or that a phone can open it. Very long text can fail to generate, and the tool will ask you to try shorter text. The code is fixed at 220 pixels wide.
content.example: Typing https://example.com and pressing Generate QR Code shows a QR code that opens that page when scanned, ready to download as a PNG.
faq: What can I put in a QR code?
Any text or web address, such as a link, a phone number or a short message. Scanning it shows the text or opens the link on the phone.
Why did my QR code fail to generate?
The text is probably too long. QR codes hold only so much data, so shorten the text or use a shorter link and try again.
Can I change the size of the QR code?
No. The code is drawn at 220 pixels wide. Resize the downloaded PNG in an image editor if you need it bigger for printing.
Does the QR code expire?
No. The code is just a picture of the text you typed. It keeps working as long as the link or text it holds still works.

tools.meta_description: Generate strong random passwords instantly, free in your browser. Passwords are created locally, never sent anywhere.
steps: Set the Length with the slider. The default is 16, and the range is 8 to 64.
Tick the character sets you want: Uppercase, Lowercase, Numbers and Symbols.
Press Generate Password, then press Copy Password to copy it.

content.use: Password Generator makes a strong random password in your browser, so you do not have to invent one yourself. A student makes a new password for a college portal. An office worker makes a different password for each work account. A shop owner makes a strong password for an online store. You choose the length and which character sets to include, and the tool builds the password with secure random numbers from your browser. Every selected set is guaranteed at least one character in the result, and a strength note tells you whether the password is weak, good or strong.
content.tip: Use 16 or more characters with all four character sets for a strong password. Copy the password with the Copy Password button and save it in a password manager, because you will not remember a random password.
content.limit: The length must be between 8 and 64 characters, and at least one character set must be ticked. The length must also be at least the number of sets you ticked. The tool makes the password; it does not save it anywhere, so copy it before you leave the page.
content.example: Setting the length to 16 with all four character sets ticked and pressing Generate Password gives a random 16-character password with upper and lower case letters, numbers and symbols.
faq: How is the password made?
With secure random numbers from your browser. No password is sent anywhere, and no two generated passwords are the same.
What does the strength note mean?
Strong means 16 or more characters with all four character sets. Good means 12 or more with three sets. Anything shorter or simpler is called weak.
Can I make a password with only numbers?
Yes, if you tick Numbers only. But a numbers-only password is weak, so use letters and symbols too for accounts that matter.
Where is my password saved?
Nowhere. The tool shows the password on the page and does not store it. Copy it with the Copy Password button and save it in a password manager.

tools.meta_description: Count words, characters and reading time, free in your browser. Paste text and see the counts instantly.
steps: Type or paste your text in the box.
Read the live counts below the box: Words, Characters, Characters (no spaces), Sentences, Paragraphs and Reading time.
Edit the text in the box and the counts update with every keystroke.

content.use: Word Counter counts the words, characters, sentences and paragraphs in your text as you type, so you can check a limit before you submit. A student checks that an essay is under 500 words. A job applicant checks that a cover letter fits the limit. A writer checks the reading time of an article before publishing it. The counts update live with every keystroke, so there is nothing to press. Reading time is worked out at 200 words per minute, which is a normal reading speed. The text never leaves your browser.
content.tip: Paste the final text, not a draft with notes, because everything in the box is counted. If the word count looks high, check for extra spaces or repeated paragraphs at the end.
content.limit: The tool counts what you type; it does not check spelling, grammar or meaning. Reading time is a rough guide at 200 words per minute and is rounded up to whole minutes. Paragraphs are counted by blank lines between blocks of text.
content.example: Pasting a 400-word essay shows Words: 400, Reading time: 2 min, because 400 words at 200 words per minute takes 2 minutes.
faq: How is reading time worked out?
At 200 words per minute, rounded up to whole minutes. A 400-word text shows 2 minutes, and a 250-word text shows 2 minutes as well.
What counts as a paragraph?
A block of text separated by a blank line. Pressing Enter once inside a paragraph does not start a new one; you need an empty line between blocks.
Do spaces count as characters?
Both counts are shown. Characters counts everything including spaces, and Characters (no spaces) counts letters and punctuation only.
Is there a limit on how much text I can paste?
No fixed limit. Very long text still counts, because the counting happens in your browser as you type.

tools.meta_description: Format, minify and validate JSON, free in your browser. Paste JSON and clean it up instantly.
steps: Paste your JSON text in the box.
Press Format to tidy it, Minify to shrink it, or Validate to check it.
Press Copy Result to copy the output.

content.use: JSON Formatter tidies, shrinks or checks JSON text, which is the data format used by most websites and apps. A student formats a messy API response so it is easy to read. A developer minifies a settings file before putting it in a project. An office worker validates a data file before sending it to a colleague. Format adds line breaks and a 2-space indent so the structure is clear. Minify removes all extra spaces so the file is as small as possible. Validate tells you whether the JSON is correct and shows the exact error if it is not.
content.tip: Press Validate first when you get an error from another app. The error message names the problem, such as a missing comma or an extra bracket, so you can fix that exact spot.
content.limit: The tool only works on valid JSON structure. It does not fix broken JSON for you; it shows the error and you correct it yourself. Very large files may be slow, because the whole text is parsed in your browser.
content.example: Pasting {"name":"Ali","age":25} and pressing Format shows the same data on separate lines with a 2-space indent, easy to read.
faq: What is the difference between Format and Minify?
Format adds line breaks and a 2-space indent so the JSON is easy to read. Minify removes all extra spaces and line breaks so the file is as small as possible.
What does Validate do?
It checks whether the text is valid JSON. If it is, the output says Valid JSON. If not, it shows the exact error, such as a missing comma.
Can the tool fix my broken JSON?
No. It only reports the error. You fix the text yourself, for example by adding a missing comma or closing bracket, then press Validate again.
Is my JSON data uploaded anywhere?
No. The text is parsed in your browser. Nothing you paste leaves your device.

tools.meta_description: Encode or decode Base64 text, free in your browser. Convert text both ways instantly, with no sign-up.
steps: Type or paste your text in the box.
Press Encode to turn it into Base64, or Decode to turn Base64 back into text.
Press Copy Result to copy the output.

content.use: Base64 turns text into a safe code made of letters, numbers and a few symbols, and turns that code back into text. A developer encodes a token to paste into a settings file. A student decodes a Base64 string from a class example to see the original message. An office worker encodes a short note to send through a system that only accepts plain letters. The tool handles any language, including Urdu, because it encodes the text as UTF-8 first. Encode and Decode both run in your browser, so your text is never uploaded.
content.tip: Base64 is a code, not encryption. Anyone can decode it, so do not use it to hide a password or a secret. Use it only to move text safely through systems that cannot handle special characters.
content.limit: Base64 is not encryption and not a password. Anyone who sees the code can decode it. Decoding only works on valid Base64 text; anything else shows an error with the reason.
content.example: Typing 'hello' and pressing Encode gives 'aGVsbG8='. Pressing Decode on 'aGVsbG8=' gives back 'hello'.
faq: Is Base64 a way to hide a password?
No. Base64 is a code anyone can reverse. It only changes how the text looks, so never use it to protect a secret. Use a real password manager for passwords.
Can I encode Urdu text?
Yes. The tool encodes text as UTF-8 first, so Urdu and other languages encode and decode correctly.
Why does Decode show an error?
The text is not valid Base64. Check for missing characters, extra spaces or a cut-off string, then try again.
What is Base64 used for?
Moving text safely through systems that only accept plain letters and numbers, such as settings files, tokens and email attachments.

tools.meta_description: Change text case four ways — upper, lower, title and sentence case — free in your browser.
steps: Type or paste your text in the box.
Press UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case or Sentence case.
Press Copy Result to copy the changed text.

content.use: Case Converter changes the capital letters in your text, so you can fix a heading, a title or a whole paragraph in one click. A student turns a shouty heading into normal title case for an assignment. An office worker turns a lowercase notice into uppercase for a poster. A shop owner turns a product name into sentence case for a price list. The four buttons cover the common cases: all capitals, all lower case, capitals on every word, and a capital only at the start of each sentence. The changed text appears below, ready to copy.
content.tip: Use Title Case for headings and names, and Sentence case for normal paragraphs. If the result looks wrong, check the original text for extra spaces, because they can split words the tool treats separately.
content.limit: The tool changes letter case only. It does not fix spelling, punctuation or spacing. Title Case capitalises every word, including small words like 'and' and 'of', so you may need to fix those by hand.
content.example: Pasting 'hello world' and pressing Title Case gives 'Hello World'. Pressing UPPERCASE on the same text gives 'HELLO WORLD'.
faq: What does Title Case do?
It puts a capital letter at the start of every word, so 'hello world' becomes 'Hello World'. Small words like 'and' are also capitalised, so fix those by hand if needed.
What does Sentence case do?
It puts a capital at the start of each sentence and lower case elsewhere, so 'HELLO. HOW ARE YOU?' becomes 'Hello. How are you?'
Can I convert only part of my text?
No. The whole text in the box is converted at once. Paste only the part you want to change, then copy the result back.
Does the tool change my original text?
No. Your pasted text stays in the top box. The changed text appears below it, so you can copy it without losing the original.

tools.meta_description: Generate secure random UUIDs instantly, free in your browser. Unique IDs created locally on your device.
steps: Press Generate UUID for one ID, or Generate 5 for five at once.
Read the IDs shown in the box below.
Press Copy Result to copy the ID or IDs.

content.use: UUID Generator makes secure random IDs, called UUIDs, that you can use as unique keys in a database, a file name or a test. A developer makes an ID for each new record in an app. A student makes unique file names for assignment uploads. An office worker makes reference numbers for a set of documents. Each UUID is a 36-character code in the standard 8-4-4-4-12 pattern, made with secure random numbers from your browser. Press Generate UUID for one, or Generate 5 to get five at once. The IDs never leave your browser.
content.tip: Use Generate 5 when you need a batch of IDs, then copy them all at once. If two systems must never share an ID, generate fresh ones for each system instead of reusing the same ID.
content.limit: The tool makes version 4 random UUIDs only. It does not make IDs based on a name, a date or a counter, and it does not check whether an ID already exists in your database. The IDs are random, so two of them will not match by chance.
content.example: Pressing Generate UUID gives one 36-character ID in the standard 8-4-4-4-12 pattern, and pressing Generate 5 gives five IDs at once, one per line.
faq: What is a UUID?
A universally unique identifier: a 36-character random code in the pattern 8-4-4-4-12. It is used as a unique key when two records must never share an ID.
Are the UUIDs really unique?
They are random version 4 UUIDs, so the chance of two matching is so small it can be ignored. The tool does not check your database, so keep your own list if you must be certain.
Can I generate more than 5 at once?
No. The tool makes one UUID or five at a time. Press Generate 5 again for another batch.
Is my UUID private?
Yes. The IDs are made in your browser with secure random numbers. Nothing is sent to a server or stored anywhere.

tools.meta_description: Convert CSV rows into JSON objects, free in your browser. Paste CSV and get clean JSON instantly.
steps: Choose a .csv file with the file button, or paste CSV text in the box. The first row must be the header.
Press Convert CSV to JSON.
Press Copy JSON to copy the result, or Download .json to save it as a file.

content.use: CSV to JSON turns rows of comma-separated data into a JSON list of objects, which is the format most apps and websites read. A developer turns a spreadsheet export into JSON for an app. A student turns survey results into JSON for a class project. An office worker turns a contact list into JSON to send to a developer. The first row of the CSV becomes the field names, and each row after it becomes one object with those names. The result is shown as tidy JSON with a 2-space indent, ready to copy or download.
content.tip: Make sure the first row holds your column names, because they become the JSON field names. If a row has a different number of values than the header, the tool stops and tells you which row is wrong.
content.limit: The CSV needs a header row and at least one data row. Every data row must have the same number of fields as the header, or the tool shows an error naming the row. All values stay as text; numbers are not converted to JSON numbers.
content.example: Pasting 'name,age' then 'Ali,25' and pressing Convert CSV to JSON gives a JSON list with one object, name Ali and age 25, shown with a 2-space indent.
faq: What does the first row become?
The field names of each object. 'name,age' as the first row makes objects with 'name' and 'age' fields.
Why did the tool say a row has the wrong number of fields?
That row has more or fewer values than the header row. Count the commas in that row and fix it, then convert again.
Are numbers kept as numbers?
No. All values stay as text in the JSON, so age 25 becomes "25" in quotes. Change the types in your app if you need real numbers.
Can I download the JSON as a file?
Yes. Press Download .json to save it, or press Copy JSON to copy the text into your own editor.

short.en: Compare two texts, line by line.

tools.meta_description: Compare two texts line by line and see what changed, free in your browser. Added and removed lines shown clearly.
steps: Paste the original text in the 'Original text' box.
Paste the changed text in the 'Changed text' box.
Press Compare Texts and read the Removed, Added and Unchanged lines shown below.

content.use: Text Diff Checker compares two versions of a text and lists the lines that were added, removed or kept, so you can see exactly what changed. A student compares a draft essay with the final version to check the edits. A teacher compares two versions of a worksheet to find new questions. An office worker compares an old price list with a new one to spot changed prices. The tool splits both texts into lines, matches them, and shows the lines that appear in only one version, plus a count of the lines that stayed the same.
content.tip: Paste the two versions in the right boxes: the older text first, the newer text second. If the result says 'No differences found', the two texts are identical line for line.
content.limit: The tool compares whole lines, not single words, and it matches lines by their text. A line that moved to another place but stayed the same is not listed as changed. The result is shown on the page and is not downloaded as a file.
content.example: Comparing a price list with 10 lines against a new list with 11 lines shows 1 line Added, 0 lines Removed, and 10 Unchanged lines.
faq: Does the tool show changed words inside a line?
No. It compares whole lines. If one word in a line changed, the whole old line is listed as Removed and the whole new line as Added.
What does 'Unchanged lines' mean?
The number of lines from the original text that also appear in the changed text. A line that moved to another place still counts as unchanged.
Can I compare two files instead of pasted text?
No. Paste the text into the two boxes. Copy the text from each file into the boxes first.
What happens if the two texts are identical?
The result says 'No differences found.' Nothing is listed as added or removed.

short.en: Exact age in years, months, days.

tools.meta_description: Calculate exact age in years, months and days, free in your browser. Enter a birth date and get the exact age.
steps: Pick your date of birth in the 'Date of birth' box.
Press Calculate Age, or just wait, because the result updates as you type.
Read your exact age in years, months and days.

content.use: Age Calculator works out your exact age in years, months and days from your date of birth, so you do not have to count it yourself. A student checks their age for a form that asks for years and months. A parent checks a child's exact age for a school admission form. An office worker checks an employee's age for a retirement record. You pick the date of birth, and the tool counts the full years, the extra months and the remaining days up to today. The result updates live as soon as you change the date.
content.tip: Use the calendar picker in the date box instead of typing the date, so the format is always right. If the date is in the future, the tool shows an error instead of a negative age.
content.limit: The age is counted up to today, using your device's date. A future date of birth is not accepted. The tool gives years, months and days only; it does not give the age in weeks or total days.
content.example: Picking 1 January 2000 as the date of birth on 18 November 2026 gives an age of 26 years, 10 months and 17 days.
faq: How is the age worked out?
The tool counts full years from your date of birth to today, then the extra months and the remaining days. The result is exact to the day.
Can I enter a future date?
No. A date in the future is not accepted, because an age cannot be negative. Pick a date in the past.
Does the result update on its own?
Yes. The calculator recalculates live as soon as you change the date, so you do not need to press the button again.
Why does it show months and days too?
Because many forms ask for an exact age, such as 17 years and 6 months. Years alone would not be enough for those forms.

tools.meta_description: Calculate percentages, shares and percent change, free in your browser. Quick percent maths with no sign-up.
steps: Choose a calculation in the 'Calculation' list: X% of Y, X is what % of Y, or Percentage change from X to Y.
Type the two numbers in the X and Y boxes.
Press Calculate, or just wait, because the result updates as you type.

content.use: Percentage Calculator answers the three percentage questions people ask most often: what is a percent of a number, what percent one number is of another, and how much a number changed in percent. A shop owner works out a 10 percent discount on a price. A student works out what percent 45 marks is of 60. An office worker works out the percent rise in sales from last month to this month. You pick the calculation, type X and Y, and the tool shows the answer in a full sentence, such as '20% of 500 = 100'. The result updates live as you type.
content.tip: For a discount, use 'X% of Y' to find the amount to take off, then subtract it from the price yourself. For a rise or fall, use 'Percentage change from X to Y', where X is the old number and Y is the new one.
content.limit: The tool needs two numbers for every calculation. For 'X is what % of Y', Y cannot be zero. For percentage change, X cannot be zero. The answer is shown as plain text; it is not saved or rounded to a fixed number of decimals.
content.example: Choosing 'X% of Y' with X as 20 and Y as 500 shows '20% of 500 = 100'.
faq: How do I work out a 10 percent discount?
Choose 'X% of Y', set X to 10 and Y to the price. The answer is the discount amount. Subtract it from the price to get the price after discount.
What does 'X is what % of Y' mean?
It tells you what share X is of Y. With X as 45 and Y as 60, the answer is 75%, because 45 is three quarters of 60.
How do I work out a price rise in percent?
Choose 'Percentage change from X to Y'. Put the old price in X and the new price in Y. A rise shows as a positive percent and a fall as a negative one.
Why does it say Y cannot be zero?
Dividing by zero is not possible. For 'X is what % of Y', Y is the whole you compare against, so it must not be zero.

short.en: BMI and category from height, weight.

tools.meta_description: Calculate BMI and its category from height and weight, free in your browser. Instant, private, no sign-up.
steps: Type your height in centimetres in the 'Height (cm)' box.
Type your weight in kilograms in the 'Weight (kg)' box.
Press Calculate BMI, or just wait, because the result updates as you type.

content.use: BMI Calculator works out your Body Mass Index from your height and weight, and tells you which category it falls in. A student checks their BMI for a health assignment. A parent checks a teenager's BMI before a doctor's visit. An office worker checks their own BMI as part of a fitness plan. You type your height in centimetres and your weight in kilograms, and the tool divides the weight by the height in metres squared, then rounds the answer to one decimal. The categories are Underweight below 18.5, Normal below 25, Overweight below 30, and Obese at 30 and above.
content.tip: Measure your height and weight on the same day for a fair result. BMI is a rough guide, not a diagnosis; it does not account for muscle, age or body shape, so ask a doctor if you are worried about the result.
content.limit: BMI needs a positive height and weight; anything else shows an error. The result is a general guide only. It does not measure body fat, muscle or health, and it is not medical advice. The calculator uses centimetres and kilograms only.
content.example: A height of 170 cm and a weight of 65 kg gives a BMI of 22.5, which falls in the Normal category.
faq: How is BMI worked out?
Weight in kilograms divided by height in metres squared. The tool takes centimetres and converts them to metres for you, then rounds the answer to one decimal.
What do the categories mean?
Underweight is below 18.5, Normal is 18.5 to under 25, Overweight is 25 to under 30, and Obese is 30 and above. These are general ranges, not a diagnosis.
Is BMI the same as body fat?
No. BMI only uses height and weight. It does not measure fat, muscle or fitness, so a muscular person can have a high BMI and still be healthy.
Can I use feet and pounds?
No. This calculator takes height in centimetres and weight in kilograms only. Convert your measurements first if you use feet and pounds.

tools.meta_description: Calculate monthly EMI, total interest and total payment, free in your browser. Plan a loan in seconds.
steps: Type the loan amount in the 'Loan amount' box.
Type the annual interest rate in percent and the loan period in years.
Press Calculate EMI, or just wait, because the result updates as you type. The result shows the monthly EMI, total payment, total interest and number of months, plus a breakdown table.

content.use: Loan / EMI Calculator works out the monthly payment on a loan, using the standard EMI formula, so you can plan before you borrow. A family checks the monthly payment on a home loan before talking to a bank. A shop owner checks the EMI on a business loan for new stock. A student checks the EMI on a small loan for a laptop. You type the loan amount, the annual interest rate and the number of years. The tool shows the monthly EMI, the total amount you will pay, the total interest and the number of months, with a breakdown table below.
content.tip: Try a longer loan period to see the EMI fall, and notice that the total interest rises. Compare the total interest, not just the monthly EMI, when you choose between two loans.
content.limit: The result is a guide based on a fixed interest rate and equal monthly payments. It does not include bank fees, taxes or changing rates, and it is not financial advice. The rate must be 0 or more, and the loan amount and years must be positive.
content.example: A loan of Rs 1,000,000 at 12 percent for 5 years gives a monthly EMI of Rs 22,244.45, a total payment of Rs 1,334,667 and total interest of Rs 334,667.
faq: What is an EMI?
An Equated Monthly Instalment: the same amount you pay every month until the loan is finished. Each payment covers part of the interest and part of the loan amount.
What happens if the interest rate is 0?
The tool divides the loan amount by the number of months. A Rs 600,000 loan over 5 years at 0 percent gives an EMI of Rs 10,000 a month.
Does a longer loan always cost more?
The monthly EMI falls, but the total interest rises, because you pay interest for more months. Check the total interest in the breakdown table before you choose.
Is this financial advice?
No. It is a calculation based on a fixed rate and equal payments. Banks add fees and may change rates, so ask the bank for the final figures before you borrow.

tools.meta_description: Calculate weighted CGPA from course grades and credits, free in your browser. Enter courses, get your CGPA.
steps: Type one course per line in the box, as: Course, credit hours, grade point. For example: Math, 3, 3.7
Press Calculate CGPA, or just wait, because the result updates as you type.
Read your CGPA to 2 decimals and your total credit hours.

content.use: CGPA Calculator works out your weighted CGPA from your courses, so you can check your result without a spreadsheet. A student checks their CGPA at the end of a semester. A job applicant checks their CGPA before writing it on a resume. A parent checks a child's CGPA for a scholarship form. You type one course per line, with the course name, the credit hours and the grade point, separated by commas. The tool multiplies each grade point by its credit hours, adds them up and divides by the total credit hours, then shows the CGPA to 2 decimals.
content.tip: Type the grade point exactly as your university gives it, such as 3.7 for an A-. If a line is wrong, the tool names it in the error, so fix that line and press Calculate CGPA again.
content.limit: The tool uses the grade points you type; it does not convert letter grades for you. Each line must have exactly three parts: course name, credit hours and grade point. Credit hours must be above zero and grade points cannot be negative.
content.example: Typing 'Math, 3, 3.7' and 'English, 3, 3.3' gives a CGPA of 3.50 across 6 credit hours.
faq: How do I write a course line?
One course per line as: Course, credit hours, grade point. For example: Math, 3, 3.7. The course name can be anything; the numbers must be in the right order.
Does the tool convert A, B and C grades?
No. It uses the grade points you type. Convert your letter grades to grade points first, using your university's scale, then enter the numbers.
What if one of my lines is wrong?
The tool shows an error naming the exact line, such as 'Invalid course line: Math, 3'. Fix that line and press Calculate CGPA again.
Why is the CGPA weighted?
Because a 3-credit course counts more than a 1-credit course. Each grade point is multiplied by its credit hours before the average is worked out.

short.en: Bill items, tax and total PDF.

content.use: An invoice generator is for freelancers, shops and small businesses that need a clean bill for a client: the work done, the quantity, the price, the tax and the total, as a PDF that can be sent on WhatsApp or email.
content.tip: Enter one item per line as item, quantity, price. Choose a template before you download. Template 2 has a coloured header and a notes line, Template 1 is plain and simple.
content.limit: The invoice is a simple formatted PDF, not a Word template or an accounting file. It does not store your invoices, and it does not calculate GST rules for you.
content.example: Design work, 2, 5000 with 0% tax gives a subtotal of 10,000 and a total of 10,000.
faq: Can I add tax to my invoice?
Yes. Enter the tax percentage and the tool adds it to the subtotal before showing the total.
Are there different invoice templates?
Yes, two. Template 1 is a plain, simple invoice. Template 2 has a coloured header and a notes line for payment details.
Can I see the total before downloading?
Yes. Press Calculate Summary first. The summary box shows each item, the subtotal, the tax and the total, so you can check the numbers.
Does it work out GST for me?
No. You enter the tax percentage yourself, and the tool adds it to the subtotal. It does not know the GST rules for your business.

tools.meta_description: Generate a bill with items, tax and total as a PDF, free in your browser. A clean invoice for your business.
steps: Type the Business name, Client name and Invoice date.
Choose Template 1 (plain and simple) or Template 2 (coloured header, with a Notes field) in the Template list.
List the items, one per line, as: Item name, quantity, price.
Type the Tax percent, press Calculate Summary to check the totals, then press Download Invoice PDF.

content.use: A resume builder is for a job seeker who needs a clean, one-page resume quickly: name, job title, contact details, skills and experience, as a PDF that can be attached to an application.
content.tip: Keep the experience short and specific, with numbers where you can: how many records, how many reports, how much time saved. Choose a template before you download.
content.limit: The resume is a simple formatted PDF, not a Word template. It does not store your resume, and it does not write the content for you.
content.example: A data analyst resume with a name, title, email, phone, skills and two jobs becomes a clean PDF in one click.
faq: Are there different resume templates?
Yes, two. Template 1 is a classic single-column resume. Template 2 has a coloured header and a different skills layout.
Can I edit the resume after downloading it?
The PDF is not editable. If you need changes, edit the fields on this page and download it again.
What do I put in the skills box?
Your skills separated by commas, such as Excel, Power BI, Reporting. The template lays them out for you in the downloaded PDF.
Can I add a photo to my resume?
No. There is no photo field. The resume has your name, job title, contact details, skills and experience only, with nothing else on the page.

tools.meta_description: Build a clean PDF resume quickly, free in your browser. Add your name, skills and experience, then download.
steps: Type your Full name, Job title, Email, Phone and Skills (comma-separated).
Choose Template 1 (classic single column) or Template 2 (coloured header, skills as bullets) in the Template list.
Write your experience in the Experience box.
Press Download Resume PDF and save the file.

tools.meta_description: Create a colour palette from one base colour, free in your browser. Complementary, analogous and triadic palettes.
steps: Pick a base colour with the colour picker, or type a hex code.
Press Generate Palette.
Click any swatch to copy its hex code.

content.use: Color Palette builds a matching set of six colours from one base colour, so you can pick colours for a poster, a slide or a website without guessing. A student picks colours for a class presentation. A shop owner picks colours for a price poster. An office worker picks colours for a report cover. You choose a base colour, and the tool works out a complementary colour opposite it, two analogous colours beside it, and two triadic colours spaced around the colour wheel. Each colour is shown as a swatch with its hex code, and clicking a swatch copies the code.
content.tip: Start with your brand or favourite colour as the base. Use the complementary colour for highlights and the analogous colours for backgrounds, so the design stays calm and matching.
content.limit: The palette is worked out from colour-wheel maths only. It does not check contrast or readability, so test the colours together before you use them in a design. The base colour must be a valid 6-digit hex code.
content.example: Picking a teal base colour such as #0F766E and pressing Generate Palette gives six swatches: the base, its complementary colour, two analogous colours and two triadic colours, each with a hex code to copy.
faq: What colours does the palette include?
Six swatches: the Base colour, its Complementary colour opposite it on the wheel, Analogous -30 and Analogous +30 beside it, and Triadic +120 and Triadic +240 spaced around the wheel.
How do I copy a hex code?
Click the swatch. The hex code is copied to your clipboard, ready to paste into your design tool.
Does the tool check if the colours are readable together?
No. The palette is worked out from colour-wheel positions only. Test light text on dark backgrounds, and dark text on light ones, before you publish.
What hex code should I type?
A 6-digit code starting with #, such as #0F766E. The colour picker fills this in for you if you pick a colour with it.

short.en: Convert Marla, Kanal, Acre, sq ft, sq yd and sq m.

steps: Enter the area in the unit you have.
Pick the unit you are converting from (Marla, Kanal, Acre, square feet, square yards or square metres).
Press Convert Land Area. All six units are shown at once.

content.use: A land converter is for the units used in Pakistan property deals: Marla, Kanal, Acre, square feet, square yards and square metres. A buyer, a seller, a patwari or a property dealer uses it to check that a 10 Marla plot and a 1 Kanal plot are being compared fairly.
content.tip: Enter the area in the unit you have, and the tool shows all the other units at once. 1 Kanal is 20 Marla, and 1 Acre is 8 Kanal.
content.limit: The tool converts area only. It does not give a price, a location, or legal advice about a plot, and it uses the standard Punjab unit sizes.
content.example: 1 Kanal is 20 Marla, 5,445 square feet and 605 square yards.
faq: How many Marla are in 1 Kanal?
20 Marla. 1 Marla is 272.25 square feet, so 20 Marla is 5,445 square feet.
How many Kanal are in 1 Acre?
8 Kanal. 1 Acre is 43,560 square feet.
How many square yards are in 1 Kanal?
605 square yards. 1 Kanal is 5,445 square feet, and 1 square yard is 9 square feet, so 5,445 divided by 9 is 605.
Can I convert from square feet?
Yes. Choose Square feet in the From list and enter the area. The tool shows the same area in Marla, Kanal, Acre, square yards and square metres.

steps: اپنے پاس موجود رقبہ درج کریں۔
یونٹ منتخب کریں، مثلاً مرلہ یا کنال۔

short.en: FBR salary tax, monthly and annual, with take-home pay.

steps: Enter your gross monthly salary in rupees.
Pick the tax year. Tax Year 2027 (FY 2026-27) is the current year.
Press Calculate Tax. The page shows annual tax, monthly tax and take-home pay.

content.use: A Pakistan salary tax calculator is for checking how much income tax is taken from a monthly salary, and what the take-home pay is. It is used before accepting a job offer, at the start of a tax year, and when a salary changes.
content.tip: Enter your gross monthly salary and pick the tax year. The current year is Tax Year 2027 (FY 2026-27). The calculator shows the annual tax, the monthly tax and the take-home pay.
content.limit: This is an estimate only, using FBR slabs for salaried individuals. It does not include rebates, allowances, other income, or tax already deducted. It is not tax advice. Tax Year 2025 is not included because its slabs were not directly verified from an official FBR document.
content.example: A monthly salary of Rs 200,000 is Rs 2,400,000 a year. In Tax Year 2027 the tax is Rs 156,000 a year, about Rs 13,000 a month.
faq: Which tax year should I choose?
Tax Year 2027 (FY 2026-27) is the current year as of November 2026. Tax Year 2026 (FY 2025-26) is there for last year's figures.
Is this the exact tax I will pay?
No. It is an estimate from the FBR slabs only. Your employer may apply rebates and allowances, so check your payslip or ask a tax adviser for the exact figure.
Does it show the tax for each slab?
Yes. Below the result there is a breakdown table. It lists each income slab, the rate on that slab, and the tax charged on it.
Do I enter my gross salary or take-home pay?
Your gross monthly salary, before any tax is taken off. The calculator works out the tax and the take-home pay from that figure.

short.en: Zakat at 2.5% with nisab by gold or silver rate.

steps: Enter your cash and bank balance, and subtract any debts.
Enter your gold and silver in tola, with the current rate per tola for each.
Press Calculate Zakat. The page shows net wealth, the nisab and the Zakat due at 2.5%.

content.use: A Zakat calculator is for working out the Zakat due on cash, gold and silver held for one lunar year. It is used in Ramadan and at the end of a lunar year, when a person checks whether their wealth has reached the nisab.
content.tip: Enter the current rate per tola for gold and silver, because the nisab depends on today's prices. The calculator uses the silver nisab (52.5 tola) when you give a silver rate.
content.limit: This is an estimate only, not religious advice. The nisab is 7.5 tola gold or 52.5 tola silver, and Zakat is 2.5% of net zakatable wealth. The government bank-deduction nisab for Ramadan 2026 was reported as Rs 503,529, but that figure was not directly verified from an official source, so it is shown only as reported.
content.example: Cash and gold worth Rs 1,000,000 above the nisab gives Rs 25,000 Zakat at 2.5%.
faq: What is the nisab?
The nisab is the minimum wealth above which Zakat is due: 7.5 tola of gold or 52.5 tola of silver. If your wealth is below it, no Zakat is due.
How much Zakat do I pay?
2.5% of your net zakatable wealth, after subtracting debts, once it has been held for one lunar year.
Can I set my own nisab?
Yes. Enter it in the Custom nisab box. If you leave it empty, the calculator uses the silver nisab from the silver rate you entered.
Does my house or car count?
No. The calculator only counts cash, gold and silver. Your house, car and other personal items are not entered and are not counted.

content.use: Amount to words is for invoices, cheques and receipts, where an amount must be written out in words as well as figures. A shop, a school and a freelancer all use it so the amount cannot be changed by adding a digit.
content.tip: Type the amount with or without commas. The tool shows the amount in English and in Urdu, with the Urdu line reading right to left.
content.limit: The tool handles amounts from 0 to 999,999,999. It writes rupees and paisa only, and it does not handle other currencies.
content.example: 125,000 becomes one hundred twenty-five thousand rupees only, and ایک لاکھ پچیس ہزار روپے صرف.
faq: Why do I need words on a cheque?
Words are harder to change than figures. A cheque with the amount in words is harder to alter, which is why banks and businesses ask for both.
Does it work for paisa too?
Yes. An amount such as 1,250.50 becomes one thousand two hundred fifty rupees and fifty paisa only.
Does it write the amount in Urdu too?
Yes. Every result shows two lines, the amount in English and the same amount in Urdu, written right to left with lakh and crore.
What is the largest amount it can write?
999,999,999 rupees. Amounts from 0 up to that limit work. A larger amount gives an error asking for a smaller one.

content.use: An Urdu word counter is for students, writers and teachers who work in Urdu and need to know how long a piece of writing is: an essay, a speech, a social media post, or a homework answer with a word limit.
content.tip: Paste the Urdu text in the box. The counter works with Urdu script and counts words separated by spaces, just like an English counter.
content.limit: The tool counts words, characters and reading time. It does not check spelling, grammar or the meaning of the text.
content.example: A 300-word Urdu essay takes about 2 minutes to read at 200 words per minute.
faq: Does it count Urdu words correctly?
Yes. It splits the text on spaces, which works for Urdu script, and it counts characters with and without spaces separately.
What reading speed does it use?
200 words per minute, which is a normal adult reading speed. Your own speed may be faster or slower.
Can I paste English text too?
Yes. The counter splits text on spaces, so English words are counted the same way. The reading time is still worked out at 200 words per minute.
How long will my text take to read?
The result shows the reading time in minutes, worked out at 200 words per minute. A 300-word essay takes about 2 minutes.

short.en: Weighted marks and merit aggregate with your own weights.

steps: Enter obtained marks, total marks and the weight for each part (up to 3 parts).
Make sure the weights add up to 100%.

content.use: A marks and merit calculator is for students applying to college or university in Pakistan, where admission depends on a weighted aggregate: Matric marks, FSc marks and an entry test, each with its own weight. It is also used for any percentage or weighted score.
content.tip: Enter the obtained and total marks for each part, and the weight for that part. The weights must add up to 100%. The tool shows each part's contribution and the final aggregate.
content.limit: The tool uses a generic weighted formula: sum of (obtained / total x 100 x weight / 100). It does not know any university's own formula, so check the official merit formula for the place you are applying to.
content.example: Matric 900/1100 at 10% weight, FSc 950/1100 at 40% weight, and an entry test 150/200 at 50% weight gives an aggregate of about 80.2%.
faq: What is a merit aggregate?
A merit aggregate combines several scores into one percentage, giving each part a weight. A part with 50% weight matters five times as much as a part with 10% weight.
What if my weights do not add up to 100%?
The tool stops and tells you the total, because an aggregate only makes sense when the weights add up to 100%. Fix the weights and try again.
How many parts can I enter?
Up to 3 parts. Fill in the obtained marks, total marks and weight for each part you use, and leave the rest blank.
Does it show each part's share?
Yes. The result lists every part with its percentage and its contribution. Part 1 at 81.82 percent with 10 percent weight gives 8.18.
